nodes.summary: For a real number $\alpha$ and a natural number $d$, an equiangular system with inner product $\pm\alpha$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is a set of unit vectors in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space such that any two distinct vectors $x$ and $y$ in it satisfy $|\langle x, y \rangle| = \alpha$.
nodes.title: Equiangular systems of unit vectors

nodes.summary: For a real number $\alpha$ and a natural number $d$, $N_\alpha(d)$ is the supremum, taken in $\mathbb{N}$, of the cardinalities of the equiangular systems of unit vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with inner product $\pm\alpha$. Here an infinite set counts as having cardinality $0$, and a set of natural numbers that is not bounded above has supremum $0$.
nodes.title: Maximum number of equiangular lines

nodes.summary: For a real number $\lambda$, the spectral radius order $k(\lambda) \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ is the least natural number $k$ such that some simple graph on $k$ vertices has an adjacency matrix with spectral radius $\max(\lambda, 0)$, and $k(\lambda) = \infty$ if there is no such graph.
nodes.title: Spectral radius order

nodes.summary: Fix a real number $\alpha$ with $0 < \alpha < 1$, let $\lambda = (1 - \alpha)/(2\alpha)$ and let $k = k(\lambda)$ be the spectral radius order of $\lambda$. Let $N_\alpha(d)$ be the maximum number of equiangular lines in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with common angle $\arccos \alpha$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
